fit_reason: Private owner selling a whole pickup truck in the cars by owner section.
findings: White paint on the doors, hood and bed looks clean with decent shine in the daylight shots
Headlight lenses look slightly cloudy/yellowed in the front three-quarter photos
Black plastic on the rear bumper step and lower front bumper looks a bit grey and faded
No interior photos beyond the gauge cluster, so interior condition can't be judged
message: Hi, we saw your listing for the 2013 Tacoma TRD Sport. It already looks well kept, but the headlight lenses look a little hazy and the black bumper trim has faded some, both quick fixes that make photos pop. We do mobile pre-sale details and can come to you. Would you like a quote?
